text:
mira: Heads up  we merged a migration guide into docs (PR #452) but CI flagged multiple issues: link-checker + snippet runner failures. Need a quick patch.

mira: Broken items: `/optkit/quant-profiles` (404) and an inline Python example that uses the pre-0.9 QuantProfile API. Also found one batching example using `kv_cache_enabled=True`.

tim: I can handle the link redirects. Where are the bad links located?

mira: docs/optimize/migration.md, docs/batching.md, and docs/optimize/quant-profiles.md (the latter is the snippet source).

kevin: Confirmed the snippet failure. Current example in the guide is:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile
q = QuantProfile(precision='int8', calibrate=True)
```
kevin: Updated API requires a dtype string and a calibrator instance now. Suggested replacement:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile, DefaultCalibrator
q = QuantProfile(dtype='qint8', calibrator=DefaultCalibrator())
```
kevin: Also, the `calibrate` kw was removed in v0.9.

jen: Is this a blocker for tomorrow's docs sync? I can delay if it's more than a quick PR.

mira: It's blocking snippet-exec in CI, so yes until we land fixes. But it's a small change.

ci-bot: PR #452  snippet-exec: 1 failed, link-checker: 3 broken links. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/452/artifacts

tim: I'll open a tiny PR to change `/optkit/quant-profiles` -> `/optimize/quantization` and swap the Python snippet. I'll also search/replace `kv_cache_enabled` -> `kv_prefetch='auto'`.

kevin: I'll add a minimal test under docs/tests/snippets/quant_profile_smoke.py that runs the doc snippet via snippet-exec so CI will catch regressions next time.

mira: Please add one bullet to the migration checklist: "SDK <0.9 -> >=0.9: replace QuantProfile(precision=...) with QuantProfile(dtype=...) and use calibrator objects instead of calibrate=True."

jen: Sounds good. Tim, ping me when your PR is ready and I'll queue a rerun.

tim: Will do. Planning to only adjust links + code samples, no prose edits. PR in 30m.

kevin: I'll draft the test and a tiny fixture for DefaultCalibrator. Should be quick.

mira: One extra note: some examples mention "continuous KV cache" and set `kv_cache_enabled=True` in runtime YAML. That flag got renamed to `kv_prefetch` with values `auto|on|off`. Tim, include that change in the grep sweep.

tim: Copy that. Running a grep across docs for `kv_cache_enabled` now.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by tim  https://ci.redwood.example/452/rerun/1

jen: Great work team. If CI still fails after fixes, we'll hold the release and triage tomorrow. Drop updates in #release-war-room. :thumbsup:

mira: Thanks all  I'll update the PR description with assigned tasks so reviewers know what's changed.
